benefit: Pumpkin vines interplanted between sweet corn rows provide living mulch that suppresses weeds, conserves moisture, and yields a second cash crop in the same footprint. Common pattern for pick-your-own and roadside-stand operations.

members.title: Pumpkin hill in alternate corn rows
members.body: Plant pumpkin hills 6 ft apart in every third corn row, three weeks after corn planting. Vines run under canopy and out into the alleys.
